prompts.name: alarm
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: single 16:9 film still for a Chinese-school children's fable 猴子捞月. Input image: storyboard.png is STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its adorable fluffy natural brown monkeys, round tan faces, dark expressive eyes, rich textured painterly storybook realism, mossy circular stone well, blue moonlit Chinese forest, jade leaves and warm golden moonlight. Create ONE full-bleed landscape scene, no montage, no panels, no words, captions, bubbles, labels, watermark or border. Natural anatomy and supported poses; feet must rest on stone rim, dry ground or tree, never on water. Keep every important subject safely inside the frame. Scene: A close-to-medium story scene matching the line 'Oh no! The moon has fallen into the well!' The small golden-brown monkey stands firmly on the broad stone well rim, gasps with widened eyes and open mouth, one hand braced on stone and the other POINTING DOWN AND INWARD at the round golden moon reflected in the water. A larger monkey, on dry ground beside the rim, turns toward the little monkey's alarm. The reflected moon is very clearly visible inside the well below them. Show surprise and urgency, not joyful laughter. Composition centers on the pointing hand, worried face and reflected moon.
